title: 12 Best Victoria's British Afternoon Tea
description: Discover the 12 best British Afternoon Tea experiences in Victoria, BC. From the iconic Fairmont Empress to hidden garden gems, find your perfect scone and cuppa.

places.name: Fairmont Empress Hotel
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Empress Blend' tea paired with the classic cucumber and cream cheese sandwiches and fresh scones.

places.name: Pendray Inn and Tea House
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Duchess Afternoon Tea' for its comprehensive selection and their excellent house-made lemon curd.

places.name: Teahouse at Abkhazi Garden
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Abkhazi High Tea' and make sure to request a table with a garden view.

places.name: White Heather Tea Room
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Big Muckle Giant Tea' if you're feeling hungry, or simply the 'Tea Plate' for a perfect sampling.

places.name: Venus Sophia Tea Room
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Bohemian Afternoon Tea' for its unique flavor combinations and wide selection of organic teas.

places.name: The Dining Room at Butchart Gardens
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal afternoon tea menu, which changes to incorporate fresh ingredients from the gardens.

places.name: Oswego Hotel
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Oswego Tea' set, specifically noting their unique savory selections which often feature local seafood or seasonal produce.

places.name: Pacific Restaurant at Hotel Grand Pacific
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic 'Afternoon Tea' service, particularly enjoying the views from their window tables.

places.name: Oak Bay Beach Hotel
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Afternoon Tea by the Sea' for the unique coastal ambiance and creative menu items.

places.name: The Courtney Room at Magnolia Hotel & Spa
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal High Tea menu for its innovative culinary twists.

places.name: Murchie's Tea & Coffee
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A pot of their 'Canadian Breakfast' or 'Victorian Cream' tea, paired with a classic scone and a Nanaimo Bar.

places.name: The Union Club of British Columbia
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their full traditional Afternoon Tea, as availability for non-members is a rare treat.
